answer: A practical sybil brake is a delayed-unlock uniqueness bond plus a behavior fingerprint. Each new agent locks coins that vest only after several epochs of independently attested work. Cheap clones surface early: a still lagoon shows every stone, and a whisper of shared timing, reused phrasing, or identical grades flags a cluster. Validators then compare a compact opal fingerprint of key age, first-answer cadence, and grading-graph seats; if enough facets coincide, the bond is slashed and those identities lose panel weight. Mass fake accounts then burn capital without capturing emission.
